feeds.title: Totschooling
feeds.description: I'm Viviana, a mom to three happy kids, including a toddler and a preschooler. I have a background in art, architecture, graphic design and teaching. My goal is to share creative early learning ideas, activities and resources with other parents and teachers of young children.

feeds.title: The Educators' Spin On It Blog
feeds.description: A resource for parents and teachers of young children that helps foster a love of learning at an early age. Fun and easy things to do with kids: learning games and activities with helpful resources for parents.

feeds.title: Hands On As We Grow
feeds.description: Hi! I am Jamie Reimer the author of this blog. Hands On As We Grow is all about learning to do hands-on activities with your kids. I share lots of practical, easy activities, and sneak in learning opportunities. You'll find here crafts, art projects, gross motor activities, and fine motor activities regularly.

feeds.title: Teacher Tom
feeds.description: A blog about teaching and learning from preschoolers. Thomas Hobson is a preschool teacher & author of Teacher Tom's First Book. He is inspired by the idea of helping thousands of educators to take their financial futures into their own hands almost as much as the idea of creating thousands of high-quality preschools.

feeds.title: Pocket of Preschool Blog
feeds.description: Your go-to source for early childhood ideas & inspiration. Authored by Jackie Kops, a preschool teacher. Her passion is to inspire you with play-based activities, themed centers, supports, and environments for your preschool, pre-k, TK, and kindergarten students.

feeds.title: Pondering Preschool
feeds.description: I see this blog as a dwelling place for my enthusiasm for 'all things early childhood'. This blog is a soft place for teachers, parents, and caregivers to land, to consider a variety of educational topics, and perhaps help us understand little ones.

feeds.title: Learning & Teaching with Preschoolers Blog
feeds.description: Learning and Teaching with Preschoolers is a place to share classroom ideas that bring magic and wonder to children's learning. Filled with ideas for theme-based lesson plans, classroom environments, and learning centers.

feeds.title: Teach Preschool Blog
feeds.description: Deborah J. Stewart writes about her observations and reflections on early childhood education, covering literacy, art, STEM, sensory play, and motor skills. Deborah holds an associate degree and a master's degree in Early Childhood Education. She has served in a broad range of roles in early childhood education over her 30 years including teaching in the classroom, serving as School Director, Curriculum Development, Professional Development Training, and Musical Director.

feeds.title: Pre-K Pages Blog
feeds.description: Pre-K Pages is a resource site for Pre-K and Preschool teachers offering activities, printable lesson plans, and themes for learning in your classroom.
